authority: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom

steps.title: Pre-Action Protocol Compliance
steps.description: Parties exchange information and attempt resolution in accordance with applicable Pre-Action Protocols before commencing proceedings.

steps.title: Filing of Claim
steps.description: Claim form and particulars of claim are filed with the appropriate civil court within the limitation period.

steps.title: Service of Claim
steps.description: Claim documents are served on the defendant in accordance with Civil Procedure Rules.

steps.title: Defence and Reply
steps.description: Defendant files a defence, and claimant may file a reply as permitted by the court rules.

steps.title: Case Management
steps.description: Court conducts case management, allocates the claim to the appropriate track, and issues procedural directions.

steps.title: Disclosure and Evidence
steps.description: Parties exchange relevant documents and prepare witness statements and expert evidence, if applicable.

steps.title: Trial
steps.description: Court hears evidence and submissions from both parties.

steps.title: Judgment
steps.description: Court delivers judgment determining the civil dispute.

steps.title: Enforcement
steps.description: Judgment may be enforced using available enforcement mechanisms if not complied with voluntarily.

escalation_paths.condition: Appeal on a point of law or procedure as permitted under Civil Procedure Rules

escalation_paths.to: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom
escalation_paths.condition: Appeal on a point of law of general public importance
